items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: My first, my real full name is Anis Burton.

ctx.x: Let's see, let me check this. Testing one, two, three. Say something. Hello, man. What's your name? Okay, it's going all right. This is an interview recorded in seminar room number two of the Howard Tilton Memorial Library. What's the day's date, Punch? What's the day's date, Punch? Today is the 20th, isn't it? 20th of August, 1959. And what's your full name anyway? We ought to get that on the tape.
My first, my real full name is Anis Burton.
And you're better known as Punch Miller.
